'''Darth Betton''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]] named his [[JG-1 landspeeder]] "[[Betty (landspeeder)|Betty]]" after her.
